_comment: Written by the trading runs (9:30a / hourly / 3:30p ET). Never contains account numbers, broker IDs, or any account other than the sandbox.

account.note: RE-PULLED LIVE AT 09:40 ET ON A CLOSED MARKET (2026-09-07 is Labor Day) against the mandated account after a fresh scope preflight that matched the mandate identifier EXACTLY AS A STRING against the connector list - one match, agentic-permitted, type cash; no first-account default, no nickname match, no balance heuristic. Every other account was discarded unread and none is summarised, totalled or mentioned in this file, in runs.json, in why.json, in the commit message or in the operator report. Portfolio and both position lists were queried live and all returned first time: 1011.15 total against 1011.15 cash, buying power 1011.15, equity_value 0, options_value 0, futures 0, crypto 0, pending_deposits 0, unsettled 0.0000. THE TWENTY-EIGHTH CONSECUTIVE IDENTICAL READ, unchanged from the 9/4 11:22 hourly and from the 9/3 close. Balances are live and current: a holiday closes the quote feed, not the account endpoints, and these came back first time. NO SPECIFICATION IS OPEN - the 9/4 HPE 54.21 entry expired unexecuted at its 15:30 fuse on Friday - so the full 1011.15 is uncommitted and nothing is claimed against settled cash. The 1.99 credit first flagged by the 9/1 open remains STABLE and remains FLAGGED rather than explained; this run found no endpoint asserting a cause and does not assert one. BOTH POSITION LISTS ARE EMPTY, so no +20% target, no -8% equity stop, no -40% option stop, no ~5 session time stop and NO OPTION NO-FLY WINDOW was reachable - each tested live rather than inherited.

entryWatch.setup: HPE day-2 pullback after the 9/3 outside reversal bar - THE 9/4 SPECIFICATION, NOW DEAD. Published 09:45 Friday, reconfirmed 10:22 and 11:22, and EXPIRED UNEXECUTED at its 15:30 fuse.
entryWatch.trigger: DEAD - EXPIRED UNFILLED, NOT KILLED AND NOT INVALIDATED. The 54.21 buy limit lapsed at 15:30 ET on 2026-09-04 with no fill. It was NOT a price miss: every 30-minute bar from 10:00 to the bell printed a high below the limit and the 10:22 run quoted a live 54.01 offer, so the limit sat through the offer and was fillable on demand all session. It died because four of Friday's nine slots never fired and no run was alive to re-quote, confirm or execute it. None of its five invalidations ever tripped - the 51.4902 low pierced two closing tests intraday and the 52.01 close finished above both, and the 49.87 mechanical stop was never touched, missed by 3.25%. CLEARED BY THE 9/7 OPEN: this row had been publishing 'armed' on the public page since 11:22 Friday, which the 9/4 retro flagged and could not fix because the retro never writes this file. An expired specification shown as armed advertises a buy no venue can fill.
entryWatch.why: Kept as a dead row rather than deleted because the record of a specification that was continuously executable and still went unfilled is the evidence for the delivery problem, not a footnote to it. Priced without editorialising, the miss SAVED 15.40 on seven shares - 4.06% of the position and 1.52% of the account - against Friday's 52.01 close, the second consecutive session in which a delivery failure was the profitable outcome. That cuts against the 8/18 loosening rather than for it, and is recorded here so the next entry inherits the number instead of the mood. HPE is not re-struck by this run: there is no session today, no live quote to strike against, and re-striking a lapsed level is the behaviour this board refuses most often. The lines that carry forward into the next live session are the 51.83 pre-print close and the 50.29 reaction-bar midpoint, both of which the 52.01 Friday close still sits above.

entryWatch.setup: NTAP - THE RUNNER-UP, kept as a watch rather than a candidate because it lost this morning's comparison on arithmetic and could win it back on a pullback.
entryWatch.trigger: THE LEVEL IS ITS 9/3 REACTION-BAR HIGH AND THE TEST IS THAT IT COMES BACK UNDER IT WITHOUT LOSING 180.77. NTAP quotes 187.25 bid / 188.00 ask at 2026-09-04T13:44:47.806891155Z, +1.30% against a 185.38 close, ABOVE its own 187.45 reaction-bar high - which is what disqualified it today: that is a breakout being bought, and the setup this rulebook names is the pullback. It is refused a second time on size, since the two shares that fit under the 40% ceiling are 37.1% of the account against seven HPE shares at 37.53%, the same money at a third of the granularity, on a 0.377% spread against 0.055%. NOT ACTIONABLE WHILE HPE IS OPEN IN ANY CASE: both are enterprise IT hardware, the mandate's ceiling is two positions and the rulebook's is two names in one complex, so a second entry here would be one position at twice the size paying two spreads. UPDATED 11:22 ET: THE FIRST HALF OF THIS TEST HAS NOW PASSED AND IT IS STILL NOT ACTIONABLE. NTAP is 185.40 bid / 185.70 ask, last 185.60, at 2026-09-04T15:22:01.500740198Z, +0.119% against a 185.38 close - it has surrendered the entire +1.30% extension that disqualified it at 09:45 and now trades BELOW the 187.45 reaction-bar high while comfortably holding 180.77, which is exactly the condition this row was written to watch for. It is refused anyway and the refusal is structural rather than a view: same enterprise-IT-hardware complex as the open HPE specification, the mandate's ceiling is two positions and the rulebook's is two names in one complex, this slot is exits-only with a default of no trade, and the daily entry mandate binds the OPEN and was discharged at 09:45. Recorded as a number so the 9/8 open inherits it rather than re-deriving it.
entryWatch.why:
Recorded so that tomorrow's run can see this was a close call decided on granularity and spread rather than on thesis, and can reverse it on evidence rather than re-deriving it from scratch. NTAP's reversal was LARGER than HPE's - it gapped to 161.00 against a 180.77 line and closed 185.38 - and if HPE's specification dies today unexecuted, NTAP is the first name to re-examine.

CARRIED FORWARD BY THE 9/7 OPEN, WITH ITS NUMBERS EXPLICITLY MARKED AS FRIDAY'S. No live quote exists today - 2026-09-07 is Labor Day. NTAP settled 185.55 on Friday, back UNDER its 187.45 reaction-bar high while holding 180.77, which is exactly the two-part condition this row was written to watch for. The structural refusal that blocked it on Friday has now lapsed with the HPE specification: that entry expired unfilled at 15:30, so there is no longer an open position or an unexpired spec in the enterprise-IT-hardware complex, and the two-position mandate ceiling and the two-names-in-one-complex rulebook ceiling are both clear. It is therefore a genuine candidate for the next live open rather than a structurally blocked one - to be re-quoted live before anything is proposed, never actioned off this stale number.

entryWatch.setup: THE NINE-NAME REACTION CLUSTER pre-registered here yesterday evening - ZS, DOCU, LULU, PATH, IOT, ASAN, GWRE, AMBA and PL. THE TEST WAS APPLIED THIS MORNING AND ALL NINE WERE REFUSED.
entryWatch.trigger: RESOLVED, NOT PENDING. The rule written before any number was known was that none of these is bought on its reaction bar, however good the print. Today is that bar for all nine and all nine are refused, unargued: GWRE -19.8%, PATH -17.7%, LULU -17.5%, ASAN -14.5%, AMBA -7.9%, ZS -3.6%, DOCU -1.9%, PL +0.3%, IOT +8.8%, each measured on the bid against its 9/3 settled close. IOT IS THE ONE THAT COST SOMETHING: +8.8% is the largest gain in the group and item 2 refuses it by name as the definitional wait signal rather than a buy. Any of these becomes eligible again only as a day-2 or day-3 pullback that HOLDS its 9/3 pre-print close, which is 177.80 for ZS, 65.97 DOCU, 121.77 LULU, 18.22 PATH, 38.75 IOT, 10.09 ASAN, 202.86 GWRE, 63.38 AMBA and 18.35 PL - all nine now quotable settled closes rather than the numbers that did not exist when this row was written.
entryWatch.why: Kept as a dead row rather than deleted because the value of a pre-commitment is only visible when the record shows it was honoured on a morning when it bound. It bound on IOT. The nine lines are carried forward so the 9/8 and 9/9 opens inherit them as numbers instead of re-deriving them.

Four of the five are CLOSING tests that cannot fire before the bell and all are clear - 52.715 against 51.83, 51.6079 and 50.29 - and the one intraday mechanical test, a TRADE below 49.87, is untouched with the session low still the 51.6079 pierce of the 13:31Z minute and the lowest print since only 52.110. The specification is confirmed on its own pre-registered tests rather than on a fresh opinion, and the limit is neither raised nor lowered.

THE RUNNER-UP HAS COME BACK UNDER ITS LEVEL AND IS STILL NOT PROPOSED. 185.40 bid / 185.70 ask at 2026-09-04T15:22:01.500740198Z, last 185.60, +0.119% against a 185.38 close, on a 0.30 spread that is 0.162% of mark - tighter than the 0.377% quoted at 09:45. REFUSED ANYWAY AND STRUCTURALLY: same complex as an open HPE specification, two-position mandate ceiling and a two-names-in-one-complex rulebook ceiling, an exits-only slot whose default is no trade, and a daily entry mandate that binds the open and was discharged at 09:45. Carried as a number for the 9/8 open.
